system.roleplaying: It is important to you to share your knowledge and experience with less-weathered heroes. Everyone grants you some measure of respect for your wisdom.
system.majorTwist: What has just proven that you're too behind the times?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Mentor
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a challenge that someone else younger already tried and failed. Use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
